scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @diary/api" "npm run dev -w @diary/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @diary/api && npm run build -w @diary/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c magenta,cyan "npm run start -w @diary/api" "npm run start -w @diary/web"
